candidates.description: The maximal diameter of the primary lung tumor as measured on baseline imaging.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Extract the maximum diameter (in cm) of the primary lung lesion from the baseline CT scan findings or impression section.
candidates.measurement_definition: The greatest axial dimension of the primary lung mass, typically measured in centimeters (cm) using CT imaging.
candidates.name: Primary Tumor Size
candidates.uncertainty: Variation in measurement axis (axial vs. craniocaudal) may occur across different reports.

citations.quote: imaging characteristics typical of primary non‑small cell lung carcinoma, squamous type
IV non‑small cell lung cancer (adenocarcinoma, right lower lobe)

candidates.description: The histological classification of the primary non-small cell lung carcinoma.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Identify the histological subtype (e.g., adenocarcinoma or squamous cell carcinoma) from the pathology report or the radiology 'Impression' section.
candidates.measurement_definition: The cell type of the malignancy as determined by biopsy pathology or radiology-based histological characteristics.
candidates.name: NSCLC Histology
candidates.uncertainty: Some reports rely on 'imaging characteristics typical of' rather than definitive pathological confirmation.

limitations: Small number of unique patients represented in the provided text.
Reliance on radiology impressions for histology in some instances rather than definitive pathology reports.
summary: The provided evidence supports the identification of primary tumor size and histological subtype as measurable baseline clinical variables in patients with stage IV non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).
